title: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. Second Quarter 2024 Webcast Scheduled for July 25, 2024 - GlobeNewswire
description: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. (NYSE: ARR and ARR-PRC) announced that it will provide a webcast of its conference call covering second quarter 2024 operating results on July 25, 2024.

title: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. Announces September 2024 Dividend Rate Per Common Share
description: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. (ARR) announced its September 2024 cash dividend of $0.24 per common share, to be paid on September 27, 2024 to shareholders of record on September 16, 2024.

title: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. Announces Guidance for October 2024 Dividend Rate per Common Share
description: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. (ARR) announced guidance for its October 2024 cash dividend of $0.24 per common share. The company has elected to be taxed as a real estate investment trust (REIT) and is required to distribute substantially all of its ordinary REIT taxable income.

title: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. Confirms October 2024 Common Share and Series C Preferred Share Dividends
description: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. (ARR) has confirmed the October 2024 cash dividends for its common stock and Series C preferred stock. The company maintains its commitment to providing consistent returns to shareholders.

title: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. Announces December 2024 Dividend Rate Per Common Share
description: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. announced its December 2024 cash dividend for common stock, with a dividend rate of $0.24 per share.

title: ARMOUR Residential REIT, Inc. Announces Guidance for January 2025 Dividend Rate per Common Share
